visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium close-up of a woman with short dark hair, dressed in an orange ribbed turtleneck sweater. She holds a sleek, metallic pink lip tint bottle vertically in her right hand, showcasing the product against a neutral, brightly lit interior background with soft white walls and a hint of a ceiling light. (2) The scene cuts to an extreme close-up of the woman's lips. She carefully applies a glossy, reddish-brown tint using a small applicator wand. Her skin is clear, and the lighting highlights the reflective texture of the lip product as it is spread evenly across her lower lip. (3) She holds a second, darker pink bottle near her face, then presents the back of her hand where a swatch of the deep rose color is visible. She applies this color to her lips and smiles directly at the lens, showing her eyes and cheerful facial expression. (4) A third vibrant red bottle is displayed. She applies the final color, posing with the product held against her chin while looking into the camera with a warm, satisfied expression. The background remains consistent with soft, even studio-style lighting throughout.
